message:
The other day, I found myself rifling through my old go-bag, a relic from my more anxious days. You know the type: stocked with enough supplies to weather a small apocalypse. As I pulled out an assortment of granola bars, flashlights, and even a deck of cards, I couldn’t help but chuckle at my gloriously over-prepared self. 

But then I thought about how that little bit of extra planning makes me feel secure, even if I never actually use it. It’s comforting to know that I have a plan, even if it’s just a backup to my backup. Do you ever find joy in being a little too prepared?
